# N4 Kanji cross-agent semantic review

Read-only repository review under PB-BATCH-DELEGATION-20261107. No repository files changed. This is cross-agent source/semantic checking, not independent human or release acceptance.

## Actionable findings

1. **P2 — retain the source-listed idiom in unit23.** `docs/content-authoring/kanji/unit-23.json` has only `気` (き; attention/spirit) for source N4_KANJI PDF28, I 読み方 row5. The source's immediately adjacent reading is `気をつけます` (きをつけます), a common idiom meaning take care/pay attention, which cannot be reconstructed accurately from the nominal gloss alone. Minimal correction: add a lexical `気をつける` (きをつける), English “take care; pay attention”, Vietnamese “chú ý; cẩn thận”, source PDF28, keeping the existing 気 record if useful. No whole textbook sentence needed. Crop: `/tmp/project-beta-batch-authoring-20261106/author_n5_kanji/cross-unit23-reading-rows.png` (row5). Full image: `reference-images/N4_KANJI-p028.png`.

2. **P2 — real prefecture reading examples missing from unit25.** `docs/content-authoring/kanji/unit-25.json` includes `県` but omits N4_KANJI PDF32, I 読み方 row7: `高知県` (こうちけん, Kochi Prefecture / tỉnh Kochi), `山口県` (やまぐちけん, Yamaguchi Prefecture / tỉnh Yamaguchi), and `秋田県` (あきたけん, Akita Prefecture / tỉnh Akita). These are actual geography, not fictional textbook personal/institutional names; their contextual readings belong to the requested common reference scope. Minimal correction: add these three lexical entries and resolve their component glyphs to the existing master inventory in unit scope. Crop: `/tmp/project-beta-batch-authoring-20261106/author_n5_kanji/cross-unit25-reading-rows.png` (row7). Full image: `reference-images/N4_KANJI-p032.png`.

3. **P2 — preserve two explicit preparatory readings in unit22.** `docs/content-authoring/kanji/unit-22.json` omits `二十分` (にじゅっぷん; twenty minutes / hai mươi phút), an explicitly bold/right-margin reading at N4_KANJI PDF24, I row4. PDF24 row10 targets `一か月前` (いっかげつまえ; one month ago / một tháng trước), but the draft reduces it to `一か月` meaning duration “one month”, losing the source temporal sense. Minimal correction: add 二十分 and 一か月前, retaining the duration entry if desired. Both are short reading facts, not copied textbook prose. Full evidence: `/tmp/project-beta-batch-authoring-20261106/reference-images/N4_KANJI-p024.png`, rows4/10.

## Scope and semantic checks

Scanned all 316 N4 master entries (221–536) in a compact view containing glyph, Han-Viet, all On/Kun arrays, English/Vietnamese character senses, example Japanese/reading/English; scanned all30 units21–50's lexical Japanese/readings/VI/EN. No wrong lexical reading or unsuitable VI/EN sense was found in that scan. Did not treat uncommon source-listed readings or empty source On/Kun arrays as missing data.

Visually compared source dictionary entries including 231必/236亡 (PDF188), 257代/259伺/260低/261倍/262係 (PDF193), 298場/301隅/302階 (PDF199), 315吹/317咲/323拾 (PDF202), 345暖 (PDF206), 375恥 (PDF211), 400数 (PDF216), 446歳/448景 (PDF223), 454界 (PDF224), 455産/458受 (PDF225), 475君 (PDF228), 512込 (PDF233), and 534問 (PDF237). Contextual irregular compounds 二十歳=はたち, 景色=けしき, お土産=おみやげ, and source suffix 君=くん are represented correctly. 伺 retains source Han-Viet TÝ/TỪ rather than arbitrarily normalizing a source variant.

Visually checked preparatory unit starts21–25 at PDF20,24,28,30,32: their review/supplement meaning and prior-volume lesson1–25 scopes are correctly retained; they are not falsely equated to ElementaryII lesson21–25. Also compared later unit reading lists at PDF36(unit26),58(unit31),88(unit38),114(unit44),140(unit50). Leading reading-word lists and contextual senses align in these samples apart from the omissions above. This spot review does not certify every contextual phrase, every later unit page, or every dictionary supplementary compound.

## Source correction status — owner decision B-U-55

All four previously corroborated draft corrections remain **`retained_for_authoring_recheck_required`**. They are authorized draft values that still need the owner's later check; none is fully closed by this review.

- N4 必231, PDF188-L: source Han-Viet header visibly says THIẾT; draft TẤT is retained under B-U-55. The source's 必ず/必要 contextual readings are correct in draft.
- N4 隅301, PDF199-R: source header visibly says ÔI; draft NGUNG retained under B-U-55. Source すみ and On グウ match draft.
- N4 界454, PDF224-R: source On line visibly says がい, while its own 世界 row has せかい. Draft On カイ retained under B-U-55.
- N5 動172, PDF204-R: 自動車/じどうしゃ is translated as xe đạp in that source row, whereas PDF190-R 車58/自59 correctly say ô tô. Draft automobile/ô tô retained under B-U-55. This fourth item was corroborated during N5 authoring; it is not part of the N4 master reviewed here.

**数400 is not a confirmed fifth source error.** PDF216-L's enlarged printed On line reads すう、す, supporting current draft スウ/ス. Scan noise is near the line, but I cannot substantiate a voiced ず reading. Do not change or add a correction solely from OCR. Enlarged evidence: `/tmp/project-beta-batch-authoring-20261106/author_n5_kanji/cross-su400-on-line.png`.

`cross-n4-before.json` and `cross-n4-after.json` record all31 reviewed SHA256s. Units21–50 were unchanged between pins. Only `docs/content-authoring/kanji/characters-n4.json` changed while review was in progress:

Read-only cross-agent review under PB-BATCH-DELEGATION-20261107; no repository files changed and no author build script executed/imported. ## Scope and evidence

Reviewed all 24 generated lesson JSON files: 108 grammar points, 120 sentence patterns, 123 examples, 1,082 vocabulary items including 293 grouped verbs. Scanned all 293 polite-to-dictionary pairs for group and form plausibility. Read all 108 grammar explanations and final typed templates. Source heading/group coverage for lessons27–50: 7,5,6,5,6,6,6,3,5,4,7,6,3,5,4,4,3,4,2,3,3,4,5,2. These are source chapter groups, not merely generated point counts.

Heading evidence checked for all48 pages; visual comparison focused on33,37,42,49,50 and lexical pages101–102,149–150. This is not a claim of every vocabulary row visually rechecked.

Nuance checks include potential vs spontaneous perception; resultant intransitive state vs intentional transitive te-aru; preparation/maintenance te-oku; completion/regret shimau; volitional intention/planning; conditional alternatives; purpose you-ni vs tame-ni; personal/possession/thing passive; nominalization/focus; event-cause te and node; humble receiving/respectful giving; function no-ni vs concessive no-ni; appearance vs hearsay sou; imminent/in-progress/just-completed tokoro vs speaker-relative bakari; evidence-based hazu/you; causative agent/object marking and permission request; honorific vs listener politeness; humble I vs humble II. No additional substantive sense error found in this bounded review.

## Corrected preliminary findings

The early build draft used te-form slots with an extra literal te, and generic GroupIII derivation mishandled 帰って来ます. Current JSON resolves these: te-form slots concatenate the auxiliary directly; 帰って来る/かえってくる is explicit. Honorific dictionaries are correct: いらっしゃる,おっしゃる,なさる,くださる. 酔います English typo is resolved and dictionary form 酔う is correct.

The source labels 似ています and ついています GroupII; current dictionary forms 似ている/ついている preserve those source surface forms. Primary visually confirmed PDF173 存じます GroupII; current 存じる is source-aligned. Do not add a source correction for it. PDF75–76 imperative table variant くれろ is preserved as a supplied valid variant, not treated as an error.

## Template/example consistency

All123 example/template links checked after NFKC, kana normalization and contextual ruby joining. 122 match the entire template; lesson29 found_1 matches its full first sentence and adds an appropriate context sentence (“under the chair”), so it is not an error. Distinct tokoro variants use dictionary, in-progress and ta slots. Other inspected types include nai+de manner, te auxiliary sequences, masu stems, causal clauses, causative te permission and noun/action-noun humble forms. Broad phrase/clause slots are descriptive; this check does not prove arbitrary generated conjugations.

## Outcome and limits

No open actionable semantic finding in the reviewed revision. The three earlier Kanji omission fixes remain passed in targeted-n4-fixes-review.md, separate from this lesson review. B-U-55 source corrections remain retained_for_authoring_recheck_required; none is closed by this cross-agent review. This is source-informed cross-agent review, not independent human acceptance, exhaustive vocabulary transcription verification, application runtime verification or release clearance.
